title: Notifications
emptyBody: Rental updates will show up here.
permissionBody: RentACar can alert you when a rental is updated or needs your approval.

bodies.RENTAL_CREATED: A renter asked to book your vehicle.
bodies.RENTAL_ACCEPTED: The owner accepted your rental request.
bodies.RENTAL_REJECTED: The owner rejected your rental request.
bodies.RENTAL_COMPLETED: The rental is complete. You can leave a rating.
bodies.AGREEMENT_CREATED: Review and approve the rental agreement.
bodies.AGREEMENT_APPROVAL_NEEDED: The rental agreement needs your approval.
bodies.AGREEMENT_FULLY_APPROVED: Both parties approved the rental agreement.
bodies.HANDOVER_PHOTOS_READY: Review and approve the vehicle photos.
bodies.HANDOVER_APPROVED: The renter approved the pickup photos.
bodies.RENTAL_BECAME_ACTIVE: Pickup is done. The rental is now active.
